name: Wainwright Torvald
title: The Wagon Yard
examine: A spoke-shave in his belt and a cottage on Garland Row he built the doors for himself. Every axle that survives the High Road's last league does so because Torvald argued with it first.
lines: The descent eats axles. The corner at the crag eats wheels. I eat well.
A cart is forty arguments held together with iron bands. I win about thirty-eight of them per cart.
Home is the first cottage on the Row, the one with the woodpile that never shrinks. My wife says I split logs to avoid conversation. My wife is right.
